verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents official OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible SDK access and explicit no-code integration with coding agents like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode, plus a dedicated 'DeepSeek Harness' in developer preview for agent-harness developers and a documented function-calling/tool-use guide — all first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that these specific agent integrations (Claude Code, Copilot, OpenCode) work smoothly in practice, and broader third-party agent-framework (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT) documentation beyond DeepSeek's own docs.
